# Named integration suites (W07b1, #10751). Nothing reads this to change what
# runs yet: W07b2 logs PR-run selection in shadow; enforcement is its own PR.
#
#   suite <name> tests <glob>     integration tests the suite owns
#   suite <name> sources <glob>   API sources whose change selects the suite
#
# Globs are repo-relative, bash semantics (`*` crosses `/`, `[!a-z0-9]` is a
# negated class). A test belongs to the FIRST suite whose `tests` glob matches
# it, else to `core`, which always runs. `core` owns no sources. A floor path
# (integration-floor-paths.txt) or a changed API path no `sources` glob matches
# selects every suite.
#
# Contract (integration-suites.test.mjs): every test a suite owns may import,
# directly, only files its own `sources` match or that no suite owns (changing
# an unowned file selects every suite). When it fails, either add the import
# to the suite (`suite <s> sources <file>`) or move the test to core
# (`suite core tests <file>`, above the suite's own tests glob).
#
# Drafted 2026-11-08 from filename prefixes with >= 15 integration tests; the
# "import evidence" lines were added until the contract held. Direct imports
# only: through db/index.ts the API's import graph is a single component, so
# the transitive closure of any test is nearly all of apps/api/src.
# ── accounting ──
suite accounting tests apps/api/src/__tests__/integration/accounting[!a-z0-9]*
suite accounting tests apps/api/src/services/accounting/accountingFeePush.integration.test.ts
suite accounting sources apps/api/src/services/accounting*
suite accounting sources apps/api/src/routes/accounting*
suite accounting sources apps/api/src/jobs/accounting*
